project management and IT service management.
Award Recognition: Honored with the Project Star award twice during my tenure at Capgemini, acknowledging outstanding project performance and contributions.
Client-Facing Experience: Extensive experience in client-facing roles, including direct engagement and onshore assignments at client

sites, ensuring alignment with project objectives and stakeholder expectations. Team Leadership & Performance Management: Managed a team of 10 resources, overseeing goal-setting, performance reviews, ratings, and Personal Improvement Plans (PIPs) to drive individual and team success.
Project Planning & Administration: Served as an administrator and project planner for CA Clarity PPM and SharePoint, ensuring efficient project tracking, documentation, and resource management.
Managed end-to-end Data Governance activities across multiple risk domains, ensuring data ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage, controls, review and approval requirements were tracked through closure.
Coordinated with Data Owners, Data Stewards and Risk Stewards to validate critical data elements, governance requirements, data-quality issues and control compliance, driving timely remediation of identified gaps.
Governed data ownership and accountability frameworks, ensuring appropriate owners and stewards were assigned to critical data assets, applications and risk-reporting processes.
Performed data-quality and governance gap assessments, identifying issues related to completeness, accuracy, consistency, ownership and metadata, and driving corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
Managed Data Visa governance workflows, coordinating steward reviews, approvals, exceptions and remediation activities while maintaining complete audit trails and governance documentation.
Maintained governance trackers and MI dashboards covering data assets, stewardship status, approvals, data-quality issues, risks, dependencies and remediation progress for senior management reporting.
Supported data lineage and metadata governance activities, ensuring critical data flows and reporting processes had appropriate ownership, documentation and traceability.
Partnered with Risk, Compliance, Technology, Business and Operations teams to embed data governance controls

into project and program delivery and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements. Executive Reporting & Governance: Led the preparation of complex top management reports, including governance decks, dashboards, data analysis, and risk assessments to guide strategic decision-making.

Coordinated with Data Owners and Risk Stewards across multiple risk domains to validate data governance requirements, resolve data-quality gaps, and obtain timely reviews and approvals.
Drove end-to-end governance tracking and escalation, maintaining RAID and Data Visa trackers, monitoring critical- path activities, escalating overdue actions, and ensuring timely closure of risks, issues, and dependencies
PMO & Ad Hoc Reporting: Played a key role in the PMO function for infrastructure management, developing and delivering ad hoc reports to meet business needs.
Process Migration & Optimization: Successfully migrated reporting processes across teams, implementing automation solutions that eliminated 85% of manual Excel-based tasks using VBA macros.
MIS Process Integration: Led the migration of MIS processes from the UK and US to Capgemini India, streamlining reporting workflows and improving data accuracy.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Since Jul’21: B BNP Paribas | Sr. PMO Manager – Data Governance | Resource Management Tools Used: MS Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Tableau
Responsibilities: • Headcount & Resource Management: Directing the management of headcount files for onshore resources across multiple locations
(Montreal, New York, San Ramon), ensuring accurate tracking and reporting of resource allocation.
Drove Data Governance program governance across cross-functional stakeholders, establishing structured stewardship, approval, risk, issue and data-quality management processes to improve transparency, accountability and regulatory readiness.
P&L Analysis & Reporting: Developing and validating Profit & Loss statements related to costs and headcount, leveraging advanced dashboard metrics to provide actionable insights for strategic decision-making.
Acted as a Data Steward, coordinating with Risk Stewards and business stakeholders to ensure data governance standards, ownership, quality controls, reviews, and timely approvals were completed.
Managed end-to-end Data Visa activities, coordinating with Data/Risk Stewards, tracking review requirements, following up on approvals, resolving gaps, and ensuring governance activities were completed within defined timelines.
Owned and maintained RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; facilitated regular reviews with stakeholders, drove action ownership, escalated critical items, and tracked issues through closure.
• Overtime Metrics & Resource Allocation: Managing overtime reporting and resource allocation to ensure efficient utilization while
adhering to budget constraints.
• Governance Reporting: Preparing comprehensive monthly and quarterly governance presentations for senior management, including
CFOs, to support informed decision-making and strategic initiatives.
• Custom Reporting: Designing & implementing tailored Excel reports to meet senior management’s needs, enhancing data accessibility
and usability.
Process Automation: Leading initiatives to automate reporting processes, significantly reducing report generation time and improving operational efficiency. Invoicing & Metrics Oversight: Compiling invoicing metrics reports, ensuring accuracy submission to relevant stakeholders.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Fostering strong relationships with onshore teams, ensuring collaboration to achieve project goals.
Mar’21 – Jul’21: First Abu Dhabi Bank as Data Goverence Analyst – Resource Management (Contract Role) Tools Used: MS Excel, SharePoint
Responsibilities: • Resource Contract Administration: Managed resource contracts, including generating Statements of Work (SOW) and Purchase
Orders (PO), ensuring compliance with organizational standards.
Procurement Coordination: Facilitated timely procurement by coordinating the submission of Purchase Requisition (PR) forms to the PMO and Finance teams.
SOW Collaboration: Worked closely with the SVM team to develop accurate SOWs, ensuring alignment with project requirements. • Resource Database Management: Maintained an up-to-date resource database, tracking contract start dates, PR, and PO numbers for effective reporting and resource allocation.
MIS Reporting: Prepared monthly & weekly MIS reports, providing actionable insights into resource utilization and project progress. Timesheet Reporting: Generated Clarity timesheet reports from Clarity PPM data, ensuring proper tracking of resource time allocation. • • Onboarding & Off-boarding: Managed seamless onboarding and off-boarding processes for resources, ensuring smooth integration into and exit from project teams.
Aug’19 – Jan’20: HSBC Electronic Data Processing, Bangalore as PMO - AVP Tools Used: CA Clarity PPM, SharePoint, TeamForge, MS Excel, MS Access
Responsibilities: • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively managed project risks and issues, tracking and collaborating with key team members to
ensure timely resolution and effective mitigation strategies.
Communication & Reporting Strategy: Developed a comprehensive communication and reporting strategy to facilitate coordination between stakeholders and support progress reviews and decision-making.
Project Mobilization Support: Assisted the Project Manager with mobilization activities, including resource onboarding and setting up Clarity plans for project tracking.
Program/Project Mobilization: Supported program and project mobilization efforts, ensuring all resources and documentation were in place for successful project execution.
Sep’10 – Aug’19: Capgemini India Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai as PMO - Sr. Consultant – P4 Level Tools Used: CA Clarity PPM, SharePoint, TeamForge, MS Excel, MS Access, BO, ITSM
Responsibilities: • Global Project Management: Independently managed global projects, providing ongoing support to stakeholders and clients from
the EU region, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Collected and analyzed data from multiple resources, providing clear and actionable insights to senior management to facilitate informed decision-making.
Risk Identification & Mitigation: Proactively identified potential risks and assessed their impact on project outcomes, implementing mitigation strategies to minimize disruptions.
Status Reporting: Prepared and distributed weekly and monthly project status reports, keeping stakeholders informed of progress, challenges, and key updates.
Performance Monitoring: Focused on keeping projects within the green zone, ensuring actual performance aligned with forecasted values to guarantee project success.
Documentation Management: Maintained comprehensive project documentation on SharePoint and TeamForge, managing access rights and permissions to ensure data security and proper access.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Fostered strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure smooth process flow, contributing to the success of current and future projects.
Project Planning & Resource Allocation: Managed project plans, dependencies, and baselines, ensuring optimal allocation of resources for project efficiency and success.
Dec’06 – Sep’10: JP Morgan Chase, Mumbai as GRC Data Guardian Analyst Tools Used: MS Excel, MS Access, BO
Responsibilities: • Data Accuracy & Insights: Ensured the accuracy of readership MIS data, providing valuable insights to management for informed

•
strategy development and decision-making. Entitlement Process Oversight: Managed the entitlement process for the Investment Banking division, facilitating client access to third-party vendor research. Led weekly Critical Path and RAID review meetings, identifying delivery risks and dependencies, validating action plans, and driving corrective actions to keep project milestones on track.
• Experienced in Data Ownership, Data Quality, Data Lineage, Metadata Governance, Data Visa, Data/Risk Steward coordination, governance reviews, regulatory data controls, RAID and Critical Path management, MI reporting and executive stakeholder management.
Prepared and presented bi-weekly program status and MI reports covering project progress, governance activities, transition/migration status, key risks, issues, dependencies, and management actions.
Partnered with Risk, Data, Business, Technology, and Operations stakeholders to drive data governance initiatives, obtain steward reviews/approvals, resolve data-related gaps, and ensure compliance with governance requirements.
Developed executive-level PowerPoint presentations and governance decks for senior management, highlighting program health, critical risks, key decisions, milestones, and required escalations.
Worked closely with Investment Banking stakeholders, including sales teams, research analysts, market heads and global vendors, to identify process/data issues and drive timely resolution.
Managed MIS data accuracy, entitlement status and reporting processes supporting Investment Banking stakeholders, improving data visibility and operational efficiency.
Gained hands-on exposure to banking data governance and business processes within an Investment Banking environment, combining data accuracy, stakeholder coordination, reporting and process improvement.
Maintained project plans and governance trackers, validated stakeholder progress updates, identified delivery gaps, and drove timely corrective actions across multiple workstreams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborated closely with sales teams, research analysts, market heads, and global vendors to identify issues and implement effective solutions.
Problem Identification & Solution Implementation: Conducted thorough research to identify problems, propose solutions, and drive necessary procedural changes to enhance efficiency.
Process Optimization: Streamlined readership metric & entitlement status reporting processes, significantly reducing processing time.
Feb’06 – Aug’06: Hewlett Packard Sales India Pvt. Ltd., Mumbai as Consultant Tools Used: MS Excel
Jan’05 – Jan’06: ANM & Associates, Mumbai as Team Member – Auditor Tools Used: MS Excel, MS Access
